proc findMarkBase(buf: var Buffer; coverage: Coverage; ligature: bool): Option[
    int] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Searches back from the current glyph for the base a mark attaches to, mirroring harfrust find_mark_base (without the last_base cache, so worst case is quadratic; TODO). The walk stops at the first non-skipped glyph that is acceptable or covered; the caller then checks coverage on that glyph.
